policy.full_repeat_requirement: Ten unique seeds and repeat IDs 1..10 in one scientific configuration
policy.numeric_matching: Absolute difference <= 0.00005 for values printed to four decimal places; no best-convention selection
policy.qualitative_comparison: Use primary convention, report every group and effect difference; ties within 1e-12. No invented significance or equivalence threshold.
policy.configuration_separation: Do not combine protocols, physical losses, validation designs, source inventories, hyperparameters, implementations or numerical environments
policy.source_data: Published workbook values are references, never independently reproduced training
policy.claim_scope: Passing training/checkpoint reload is code success; independent scientific claims require the rule-specific evidence

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Audit four sources and count batteries/samples under explicit row/cycle/pair definitions. Report count agreement only; no diversity inference from file count alone.
claim_assessments.published_statement: 387 batteries and 310705 samples cover four datasets with diverse chemistries/protocols
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: All55 XJTU trajectories must map to six documented groups. Replot capacities; label periodically measured/interpolated capacity.
claim_assessments.published_statement: 55 XJTU cells have six protocol-dependent degradation trajectory groups
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Separate successful training on provided features from independently extracted feature agreement. Raw I/V/time are required for the latter; kurtosis convention conflict remains unresolved until checked.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Short pre-full-charge current/voltage windows support generally applicable features
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Compute11x16 Pearson coefficients and show chemistry/protocol group comparisons. Similarity is exploratory support only; causal chemistry interpretation is unavailable without controls.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Feature-SOH correlation pattern may depend more on chemistry than protocol
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: For11 complete regular groups compare PINN to both baselines for MAE/MAPE/RMSE. Report each win/tie/loss and total; 'most' means strictly more than half of the33 group-metric cells. No universal claim.
claim_assessments.published_statement: PINN has smallest regular estimation error in most settings
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Compare repeat SD for all33 regular group-metric cells, separately ddof0/ddof1. Report win/tie/loss; smaller mean error alone does not establish stability.
claim_assessments.published_statement: PINN is more stable across tasks and metrics
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Match architecture and parameter counts exactly; CPU timing is descriptive unless hardware/software match. Report measured setup and ratio, not an exact timing claim on different cloud CPU.
claim_assessments.published_statement: PINN inference F and MLP have same structure and parameter count; CNN similar; CPU inference timing is reported
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: For all28 small-sample group/n cells compare three models on MAPE/RMSE. A best-in-all statement requires no loss; otherwise report the supported subset and counterexamples.
claim_assessments.published_statement: PINN performs best in the tested small-sample settings
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: For each group/model report n1->n4 error change and each adjacent change. General improvement uses negative endpoint difference in more than half of compared settings; strict monotonicity requires every adjacent difference <=0.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Performance generally improves as more training batteries are used
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Report RMSE(PINN n1)-RMSE(MLP/CNN n3/n4) for XJTU1/HUST. Nonpositive is an empirical outperform/tie; positive cannot be declared equivalent because paper specifies no equivalence margin.
claim_assessments.published_statement: One-battery PINN can approach MLP/CNN using three or four batteries
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Require6 batches x4 sizes x3 models x10 independent repeats, with batch1 overlap counted once, and all exact test IDs checked.
claim_assessments.published_statement: All six XJTU batches have three-model small-sample results for one to four batteries, ten repeats
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: For each of12 directions pair each fine-tune with its own source-only target predictions. Require fixed-G identical hashes and F update; report RMSE change and repeats improved. Support for all directions requires all12 mean differences <0.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Fine-tuning with frozen G improves on source-only target evaluation
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: For12 directions compare fine-tune RMSE to matched target-only n1. Require identical target tests, training battery, seed convention, validation and numerical protocol; otherwise label unmatched and do not infer improvement.
claim_assessments.published_statement: One target battery plus pretraining can outperform one target battery from scratch
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: For directions targeting XJTU1/TJU3 compare fine-tune RMSE to matched target-only n2 and list every direction. Report direction-specific outcomes; broad all-target wording is not assumed.
claim_assessments.published_statement: For XJTU/TJU, one-battery fine-tuning may outperform two-battery target-only training
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Report chemistry-class effects for the complete transfer matrix with target difficulty and source error. Exploratory associations cannot establish chemistry as the cause or guarantee transfer.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Same-chemistry transfer directions appear more promising
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Report dataset-equal, batch-equal, battery-equal and sample-pooled PINN MAPE. Label0.87% headline reproduced only under an explicitly stated aggregation; original overall weighting is unspecified.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Overall reported MAPE is 0.87 percent
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Audit actual formulas and parameter gradients. Distinguish current author loss, publication label-only loss (zero model gradient), and prediction monotonicity; each is a separate protocol. No loss-importance conclusion without added labeled ablation.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Data, PDE and monotonicity losses define the proposed PINN
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Require unchanged-G hashes, changed-F proof and improved transfer versus source-only. This supports usefulness of reused dynamics only; electrochemical identifiability remains unavailable.
claim_assessments.published_statement: G contains transferable degradation dynamics
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Audit test identities, disjoint batteries, normalization fit scope and checkpoint selection. Report demonstrated controls and remaining unknowns; design rationale alone cannot prove absence of all leakage.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Feature selection and cross-battery testing are intended to avoid leakage
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Source audit can verify first derivatives are used. No accuracy/complexity superiority without derivative-order comparison; publication reports no such ablation.
claim_assessments.published_statement: First-order derivatives balance accuracy and computational complexity
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim

claim_assessments.decision_rule: Summarize supported regular/small/transfer results. Faster learning requires matched convergence/work/time evidence; BMS usefulness requires deployment testing. Scheduler throughput is not model-learning evidence.
claim_assessments.published_statement: Physical knowledge helps models learn better and faster and may support BMS development
claim_assessments.warning: Training completion or a rounded numeric match alone does not establish this claim
